verdict.rationale: Orama's docs say the Cloud REST APIs are private and that no OpenAPI document, interactive reference or sandbox is published. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404, so there is no evidence of an interactive API reference with runnable examples. The axis applies to a search/database product with public APIs, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
